label: Removing excess metal
subgoals: Multiply the limit by the gate area to get the allowed metal
Subtract it from the connected metal
Choose a fix that removes at least that much from the layer

label: Sizing the diode protection
subgoals: Compute the net's ratio from metal and gate area
Divide the excess over the limit by the protection per cell
Round up to whole diode cells

label: Diodes on nets with several gates
section: Diodes on nets with several gates
subgoals: Sum the gate areas of every gate on the net
Compute the net's ratio and its excess
Insert enough diode cells for the whole net
